name: Skin Comics Tattoo
bio:
Immerse yourself in the artistry of Skin Comics Tattoo, a haven where illustrative mastery and intricate dotwork come to life on skin. Nestled in the vibrant heart of Schiltigheim at 8 rue d'Adelshoffen, our studio offers a unique blend of personal expression and meticulous detail. Open Tuesday to Friday from 10 am to 7 pm, and Saturdays until 2 pm, we invite you to transform your visions into enduring ink.
